title: CausalDS: Benchmarking Causal Reasoning in Data-Science Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.08093v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act as data-science agents, combining abstract reasoning with advanced tool use. Yet the relevant benchmark landscape largely divides into symbolic causal reasoning benchmarks without realistic data analysis or data analysis benchmarks without causal data-generating structure or a range of causal data science tasks. Existing causal evaluation datasets are often restricted to curated examples from existing sources, with diversity coming from limited templatized variations rather than from systematic generation of novel synthetic causal structures. We introduce CausalDS, a benchmark for evaluating causal reasoning in agentic data-science workflows. Each benchmark instance is a scene consisting of a sampled structural causal model (SCM) with generated observational data and an accompanying synthetic natural-language story grounded in a real domain. We ground the composition of the benchmar

translated_title: CausalDS：数据科学智能体中因果推理的基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型日益扮演数据科学智能体的角色，将抽象推理与先进的工具使用相结合。然而，相关基准测试领域大致分为两类：一类是缺乏真实数据分析的符号化因果推理基准，另一类是缺乏因果数据生成结构及一系列因果数据科学任务的数据分析基准。现有的因果评估数据集通常局限于来自现有来源的精选示例，其多样性源于有限的模板化变体，而非系统性地生成新颖的合成因果结构。我们提出了CausalDS，一个用于评估智能体化数据科学工作流中因果推理能力的基准。每个基准实例是一个场景，由一个采样得到的结构因果模型（SCM）及其生成的观测数据，以及一个基于真实领域的配套合成自然语言故事组成。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CausalDS基准，通过系统性地生成结构因果模型、对应的观测数据以及基于真实领域的自然语言场景，填补了现有基准在评估数据科学智能体因果推理能力方面的空白。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CausalDS, a benchmark that systematically generates structural causal models with observational data and domain-grounded natural-language scenarios to evaluate causal reasoning in agentic data-science workflows.
